title: Climbing Wall
description: Schema for a climbing wall definition and its holds (Beta Engine MVP).

cell_size_cm.description: Real-world size of one grid cell in centimetres. Used by the physics + reachability layers; defaults to 20 cm if absent.

wall_angle_deg.description: Deviation from vertical. 0 = vertical, +ve = overhang (top tilted toward the climber), -ve = slab. Physics layer rotates gravity by this angle in the wall-plane.

surface_friction.description: Friction coefficient for the bare wall surface (used for smearing). 0 = ice, 0.7 ≈ chalked plastic, 1.0+ ≈ very textured wall.

orientation_deg.description: 0 = up, increases clockwise; indicates the direction of pull/grip.

color.description: Hex code (#RRGGBB) or any free-form color name.

friction.description: Per-hold friction coefficient. Optional; physics layer falls back to a per-type default if absent.

positivity.description: How much the hold mechanically catches the hand/foot. 1 = a perfect bucket, 0 = a tiny smear. Drives max usable force in the physics layer.

max_force_n.description: Optional explicit cap on the load this hold can take in newtons. If absent, derived from positivity + grip strength.
